one_line: Open-source, self-hostable CRM platform (React/TypeScript/PostgreSQL) with REST and GraphQL APIs and built-in agent/MCP support.
auth_notes: REST API authenticates with an API key (workspace-level); GraphQL API available; self-hosted deployments use their own auth. Open-source core means you can run it yourself and fully control credentials.
self_serve_notes: Open-source and free to self-host; managed cloud also has a free tier. No approval needed.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Covers core CRM objects (companies, people, opportunities, notes, tasks); ecosystem still maturing vs Salesforce/HubSpot
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported for object/record change events

existing_mcp.note: MCP is a documented, built-in capability of Twenty ('Agents operate inside your data model... Skills, Tools, MCP'); community servers also exist

evidence.note: Fetched page was marketing/positioning, not API reference; API/MCP/webhook facts from knowledge of the project and docs URL

agent_notes: Fetched text confirms open-source, self-hostable, MCP. Endpoint specifics and webhook details not in the fetched page - based on knowledge.
